```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment with entity reference &internal; -->
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with markup <tag>&internal;</tag> ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY company "ACME Corp">
  <!ENTITY trademark "™">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramDTD;
]>
<?xml-target data="processing-instruction-value"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment 1: &company; -->
  <item id="i1" ns:attr="val">
    <![CDATA[ <item>&company;&trademark;</item> ]>]>
  </item>
  <note>Internal note</note>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Value 2">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY complex '&e2; deep expansion'>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/m">
  <!-- Comment containing PI-like syntax <?pi?> and entity &complex; -->
  <m:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text containing <brackets> and entities like &complex;
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <section>&complex;</section>
</doc>
```

  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "DataA">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "DataB &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %p1;
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:db="http://example.org/db">
  <!-- Metadata comment -->
  <db:record>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with special chars: < > & " '
    ]]>
  </db:record>
  <meta>&ent2;</meta>
</database>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY textEnt "Standard Text">
  <!ENTITY % extEnt "<!ENTITY nested 'Nested &textEnt;'>">
  %extEnt;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docFile SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="test"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment with &nested; entity -->
  <file xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw content: &nested; inside CDATA remains unparsed.
    ]]>
  </file>
  <file>&nested;</file>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item code CDATA #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY storeName "Global Store">
  <!ENTITY % dtdBlock "<!ENTITY storeAddress '123 XML Way'>">
  %dtdBlock;
]>
<?xml-log target="syslog" level="debug"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inv" xmlns:i="http://example.org/inv">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <i:item code="X-001">
    <![CDATA[
      <inventory>
        <name>&storeName;</name>
        <address>&storeAddress;</address>
      </inventory>
    ]]>
  </i:item>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test)*>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!ENTITY % macroParam "<!ENTITY extraParam 'ExtraValue'>">
  %macroParam;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="suite.xsl"?>
<suite xmlns="http://example.org/suite" xmlns:s="http://example.org/suite" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Suite-level comment for testing parser robustness -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with &base; and &derived; references.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <s:test>&derived; - &extraParam;</s:test>
</suite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE log [
  <!ELEMENT log (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY warning "Warning Level">
  <!ENTITY error "&warning;: Critical Failure">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY internalLog 'System OK'>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-audit timestamp="2023-10-01"?>
<log xmlns="http://example.org/log" xmlns:l="http://example.org/log">
  <!-- Log start comment -->
  <l:entry>
    <![CDATA[
      [LOG ENTRY] &error; | &internalLog;
    ]]>
  </l:entry>
  <entry>&error;</entry>
</log>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "SecretToken">
  <!ENTITY % secDef "<!ENTITY secToken 'Secured-&token;'>">
  %secDef;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-security policy="strict"?>
<container xmlns="http://example.org/container" xmlns:c="http://example.org/container" xmlns:x="http://example.org/ext">
  <!-- Comment containing entity &secToken; -->
  <c:content>
    <![CDATA[
      Protected CDATA content with markup <node>&secToken;</node>
    ]]>
  </c:content>
  <x:content>&secToken;</x:content>
</container>
```

<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task*)>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY taskName "BuildTask">
  <!ENTITY fullTask "&taskName; execution in progress">

  %taskMacro;
]>
<?xml-workflow status="running" step="3"?>
<project xmlns="http://example.org/project" xmlns:p="http://example.org/project">
  <!-- Workflow execution comment &fullTask; -->
  <p:task>
    <![CDATA[
      Task details: &fullTask; [Status: &taskStatus;]
    ]]>
  </p:task>
  <task>&taskStatus;</task>
</project>
